Stated Claim / Post Context:
Frost flower season is now in Middle Tennessee. Here’s what you need to know

The next few mornings could offer a chance to see frost flowers in Middle Tennessee and Southern Kentucky. Here’s where to look around sunrise.

Actual Article Body:
NASHVILLE, Tenn. (WSMV) - It’s officially frost flower season in Middle Tennessee. The next few mornings will be a great chance to spot frost flowers around daybreak.

Frost flowers form when the ground is still warm and air temperatures drop below freezing. Water in the ground travels up the stems of plants.

When air temperatures dip to freezing, it freezes the water within the stem, which causes the water to expand and rupture the stem. The ice inside the plant curls out in ribbons of ice that resemble petals.
